title: Derepressing nuclear pyruvate dehydrogenase induces therapeutic cancer cell reprogramming
model: 143B osteosarcoma cells, genome-wide CRISPR activation library
paper_calls: ELMSAN1 (MIDEAS) activation blunts ISX9; no gene table accessible
barcs_calls: 86 genes at FDR 0.10 after control calibration (38 enriched in ISX9); 46 against the control-guide null
verdict: ELMSAN1, the paper's hit, is the strongest gene in BARCS: all ten of its guides with reads rise under ISX9 (four by about 3- to 4.6-fold). The rest of the screen is weak, and non-targeting guides were over-dispersed (20% at p < 0.05), so the hit list was calibrated to them.
